title: rusolve.help/1
description: The machine-readable command schema `rusolve --help --json` prints. `rusolve <command> --help --json` prints the same object with the one command in `commands`. Generated from the command registry in crates/rusolve-cli/src/commands.rs; the HiGHS option names behind --opt are not copied here but listed by `rusolve options --json`.

commands.description: Every subcommand, in the order `rusolve --help` lists them.

name.description: The flag, with its leading dashes.

value.description: The placeholder of the value it takes (`SECONDS`, `text|json`), or null for a switch.

type.description: The kind of its value, as `commands::ValueKind` and `commands::parse_flags` check it: the same fact as `value` in machine-readable form. A `Choice` lists its values in `choices` and in `value`, joined by `|`.

choices.description: The values a `choice` flag accepts, in the order `--help` lists them. Only on a `choice` flag.

default.description: The documented default value, or null when there is none or it depends on the model.

stack.description: Which solver stack honours the flag. 'both' flags mean the same on the HiGHS port and on the native stack; a flag of the other stack is a usage error (exit 2) that names the stack.

output_schema.description: The schema_version of the command's JSON output (`--format json`), or null when it has none.

exit_codes.description: The exit-code table, the same for every command, keyed by code.

options.description: The command that lists the HiGHS options `--opt` accepts.

environment.description: The command that lists the environment variables the solver reads.
